riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who combine an outgoing personality, patience, and sharp observation. Stay steady in crowds and keep watching safety.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This work develops patience amid crowds. You need communication and de-escalation skills while staying alert to safety. It suits outgoing, dependable people who tolerate repetition.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers Social, Realistic, and Enterprising work (Social S + Realistic R + Enterprising E).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「外向 + 耐心 + 眼尖」凑一块的人——人多要稳，安全要盯。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「在热闹里保持耐心」——既要会沟通安抚，也要眼尖会看安全。适合外向、踏实、扛得住重复的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好社会、实际、企业（社会 S + 实际 R + 企业 E）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people who combine courage, care, and patience. Animals need control, and people need reassurance.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This work develops composure in conflict. Workers must handle animals and communicate with distressed owners. It suits patient, courageous, careful people.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic, Social, and Enterprising interests (Realistic R + Social S + Enterprising E).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「胆大 + 心细 + 有耐心」凑一块的人——动物要控，人也要稳。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「在冲突里稳住」——既要会处置动物，也要会跟情绪激动的主人沟通。适合有耐心、胆大心细的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好实际、社会、企业（实际 R + 社会 S + 企业 E）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people with skilled hands and an eye for quality. Gradually restoring a crushed vehicle creates a visible and rewarding sense of craftsmanship.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The satisfaction comes from restoration. A badly damaged vehicle can leave the shop looking new, and the owner's approval provides direct recognition of the craft. The role suits hands-on people who pursue detail and do not mind grease.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic (R) + Conventional (C) + Investigative (I)

breadcrumb.label: 汽车车身与玻璃维修工

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「手上有活、眼里有光」的人——把撞瘪的车一点点修回原样，那种看得见的手艺成就感很治愈。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的成就感在「还原」——一台撞得不成样的车，交出去时和新车一样，车主满意地开走，那种手艺被认可的感觉很直接。适合动手能力强、追求细节、不排斥油污的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 实际型 R + 事务型 C + 研究型 I

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: The most rewarding moment is finding the fault. After a prototype returns with abnormal road-test data, repeated investigation can reveal a loose wiring connection. Presenting that answer to the team creates a clear sense of achievement earned through careful data work.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The strongest appeal is direct contact with emerging vehicle technology. Technicians test models before launch and follow projects from prototypes to mass production, handling first-hand proving-ground data throughout the process.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic R + Investigative I + Conventional C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行最爽的是「发现问题的那一下」：样车路试回来数据异常，你反复排查，最后定位到一根线束的虚接——全团队开会时你说出答案，那种「我找出来的」的成就感，是数据流里熬出来的高光时刻。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最带劲的是「能亲手摸到车的前沿」：你测试的可能是还没上市的新车型，跟着项目从样车到量产，试车场里的一手数据都经过你的手，这份参与感很实在。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 现实型 R + 研究型 I + 常规型 C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career combines outgoing energy, steady hands, and calm under pressure. Each cup must be consistent, guests need conversation, and pace must balance with quality.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This work develops rhythm in the hands. Baristas must understand beans and extraction and stabilize each cup during a three-minute rush. It suits outgoing people who can focus behind the bar and accept responsibility for quality.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers social, enterprising, and creative work (Social S + Enterprising E + Artistic A).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「外向 + 手稳 + 能在高峰冷静」凑一块的人——一杯要稳，客人要聊，节奏和品质要平衡。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「手上的节奏感」——既要懂豆子和萃取，也要有在三分钟高峰里稳住一杯的能力。适合外向、坐得住吧台、又愿意对一杯品质负责的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好社交、务实也创造（社会 S + 企业 E + 艺术 A）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people who combine decisive action + resilience + foresight. Direction must be sound, results must be owned, and teams must be led.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This career tests ownership and foresight. One wrong direction can waste years, and a divided team can destroy the business. It suits people who decide under pressure, own results, and enjoy finding clarity amid uncertainty.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers leadership, analysis, and working with people (Enterprising E + Investigative I + Social S).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「敢拍板 + 能扛压 + 有远见」凑一块的人——方向要准，结果要兜，队伍要带。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最磨「扛事与远见」——一个方向选错，几年白干；一支队伍带散，江山就塌。适合敢拍板、能扛压、又愿意为结果兜底的人，也享受在不确定里找确定性。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好主导、重思考、也务实（企业 E + 研究 I + 社会 S）。

breadcrumb.label: Cutting, Punching, And Press Machine Setters, Operators, And Tenders, Metal And Plastic

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who enjoy die setup, machine adjustment, and producing acceptable batches. Every passing batch confirms their craft.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The craft turns sheet metal into acceptable parts. Die alignment and parameter accuracy directly determine product success. People who enjoy machinery, work well with their hands, and want to learn CNC technology can find grounded achievement here.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic (R) + Conventional (C) + Investigative (I)

breadcrumb.label: 金属冲压与剪压设备操作工

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合享受「装模调机、批量出合格件」的人——每一批合格产品，都是对自己手艺的确认。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的价值在「把铁板变成合格零件」的手艺——模具装得正不正、参数调得准不准，直接决定产品成败。喜欢机械、动手能力强、愿意学数控技术的人，会在这里找到踏实的成就感。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 实际型 R + 事务型 C + 研究型 I

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who combine attention to detail, steady hands, and patient skills. The workflow must remain smooth and sterile while both dentist and patient receive support.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field develops careful hand-eye coordination. Dental assistants understand the workflow, reassure patients, and take responsibility for aseptic practice. It suits people who remain steady, tolerate seated clinical work, and enjoy preparing and turning over a chair efficiently.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers helping people, practical work, and orderly processes (Social S + Realistic R + Conventional C).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「细心 + 稳手 + 会待人」凑一块的人——流程要顺也要净，患者和医生都要顾。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「手眼配合的细心」——既要懂流程又会安抚人，适合稳得住、坐得住、又愿意对无菌负责的人，也享受一把椅位从铺到收的利落。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好助人、务实、也讲次序（社会 S + 现实 R + 常规 C）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: If you value the steady work of accompanying another person's growth, this career offers meaning rooted in real human relationships rather than compensation alone.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The work creates meaning through visible human growth. A participant can recover from a difficult period through courses and care, or develop from volunteer to leader. Those deep relationships are uncommon in ordinary office work.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Social S + Enterprising E + Conventional C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 如果你享受「陪着一个人慢慢成长」的踏实感，这份工作给的不是薪水表上的数字，而是人与人之间真实的重量。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的意义感来自「见证人的改变」：有人通过课程和关怀走出低谷，有人从志愿者成长为带领者，这种深度的人际连接，是办公室工作给不了的。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 社会型 S + 企业型 E + 常规型 C

breadcrumb.label: Door To Door Sales Workers, News And Street Vendors, And Related Workers

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits articulate, energetic people who tolerate rejection. Each day's sales and the repeat customers built across a territory provide the strongest sense of achievement.
riasec_fit_block.interest: Value comes from closing the sale. Two people can sell the same item, but the person who starts conversations, reads reactions, and turns rejection into repeat business earns a different income. Independent, articulate people who tolerate setbacks can enjoy earning directly from their skill.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Enterprising E + Social S + Conventional C

breadcrumb.label: 上门销售员与街头摊贩及相关人员

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「嘴皮子利索、腿脚勤快、不怕碰壁」的人——一天成交几单、攒下一片熟客，就是你最大的成就感。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的价值在「成交」：同样是卖一件东西，你会找话头、会看脸色、会把拒绝聊成回头客，一天的收入就完全不一样。喜欢自由、不怕碰壁、嘴皮子利索的人，会在这里找到「靠本事吃饭」的痛快。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 企业型 E + 社会型 S + 事务型 C

breadcrumb.label: Energy Engineers, Except Wind And Solar

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This role suits people who combine practicality, data fluency, and resilience under cost pressure. Energy use must be quantified, retrofits must be achievable, and system choices must align with economics.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This work develops an engineer's sense for financial accountability. Energy Engineers understand processes and systems and insist that each unit of energy earn back its cost. It suits practical people who can focus deeply, accept cost responsibility, and enjoy carrying projects from audit through implementation.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers investigation, practical work, and enterprise (Investigative I + Realistic R + Enterprising E).

breadcrumb.label: 能源工程师（风电与太阳能除外）

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「务实 + 数据 + 能扛成本」凑一块的人——能耗要算得清也要改得动，系统和算账要平衡也要会推。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「账里的工程感」——既要懂工艺和系统，也要有把每一度电费算回来的较真。适合务实、坐得住、又愿意对成本负责的人，也享受从审计到落地的闭环。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好务实、钻研、也创造（企业 I + 现实 R + 企业 E）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: The role suits people who treat the mountains as their workplace. Bringing trees down accurately and bucking logs neatly provides a clear measure of a day's work.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The appeal lies in making a decisive cut. Judging the direction and bringing down a large tree cleanly produces a direct sense of accomplishment. People who enjoy outdoor work, have strong stamina, and treat safety as absolute can build a grounded career around practical skill.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic (R) + Conventional (C) + Enterprising (E)

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「把大山当工场」的人——树倒得又准又稳，原木造得整整齐齐，就是一天最直接的成就。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的豪迈感在「一锯定乾坤」：判断倒向、干净利落放倒一棵大树，林子里回响着倒树的声音，比什么口号都直接。你喜欢户外、体力好、又认「安全第一」的死理，会在这里找到靠手艺吃饭的踏实。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 实际型 R + 事务型 C + 企业型 E

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: If you enjoy helping a novice become independently capable, this work provides deep educational fulfillment. Every student improvement carries your influence.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The occupation becomes more valuable with age. Professionals combine physician or nursing experience with teaching, accumulating clinical and instructional expertise while academic rank and industry reputation rise. Medical education remains essential and professionally stable.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Social S + Investigative I + Artistic A

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 如果你享受「把一个不懂的学生带到独立上手」的过程，这行会给足你育人成就感——学生的每一次进步，都有你的影子。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的价值在于「越老越值钱」：既是医生/护士又是老师，临床经验加教学经验双重积累，职称和行业声望都在涨；同时医疗教育是刚需，专业地位稳定。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 社会型 S + 研究型 I + 艺术型 A

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who enjoy making things by hand and take pleasure in precision. Turning a blank into a precision part is the machinist's distinctive craft.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The most compelling part of this field is the satisfaction created by precision: your machining tolerance can be a fraction of a human hair. Watching a blank become a gleaming part under a cutting tool and then measuring a perfect dimension with a micrometer creates an addictive sense that your work stands up to measurement.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic R + Investigative I + Conventional C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「喜欢亲手做出东西、享受精度」的人——把一块毛坯变成精密零件，是机械师独有的浪漫。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最迷人的是「精度带来的成就感」：一根头发丝的几分之一，就是你加工的公差。看着毛坯在刀下变成闪闪发亮的零件，然后用千分尺量出完美的尺寸，那种「我做的东西经得起测量」的踏实感很上瘾。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 实际型 R + 研究型 I + 事务型 C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work combines organization, coordination, and emergency resilience. Workflows must be clear, communication balanced, and resources managed smoothly.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field develops accuracy amid disorder. Professionals must build clear workflows and handle on-site emergencies. It suits organized coordinators who own results and enjoy the full process from initiation to teardown.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers practical work, helping others, and creativity (Enterprising E + Conventional C + Social S).

breadcrumb.label: 会议、会展与活动策划师

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「条理 + 张罗 + 能扛突发」凑一块的人——流程要排得清也要扛得住，沟通和统筹要平衡也要会来事。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「乱中不出错」——既要排得清流程，也要扛得住现场突发。适合条理性强、爱张罗、又能对结果负责的人，也享受从立项到散场全过程。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好务实、助人、也创造（企业 E + 常规 C + 社会 S）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people who combine dependability, attention to detail, and sensitivity to numbers. Data must be accurate and decisions must be decisive, balancing records and interpretation while maintaining compliance.
riasec_fit_block.interest: What this career develops most is persistence with deviations. You must understand data and standards and be willing to sign a release decision. It suits dependable people who remain focused and are sensitive to numbers, and who enjoy tracing problems to their source.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers practical, investigative, and orderly work (Realistic R + Investigative I + Conventional C).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「踏实 + 细致 + 对数字敏感」凑一块的人——数据要准也要敢判，记录和判读要平衡也要合规。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「和偏差较真」——既要看得懂数据和标准，也要敢在放行单上签字。适合踏实、坐得住、对数字敏感的人，也享受把问题查到根上的过程。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好务实、研究、也讲秩序（现实 R + 研究 I + 常规 C）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who combine practicality, curiosity, and a systems mindset. You need to understand mechanisms and controls, balance accuracy and cost, and work on-site.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field develops connections between software and hardware. You need to understand mechanics and controls while balancing cost, accuracy, and cycle time. It suits practical, hands-on people willing to take responsibility for delivery.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: They tend to be practical and hands-on while investigating systems (Realistic R + Investigative I + Enterprising E).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「务实 + 钻研 + 系统观」凑一块的人——机构要懂、控制要会、精度和成本要平衡也要跑现场。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「软硬之间的衔接」——既要懂机械和控制，也要在成本、精度、节拍间找平衡。适合务实、爱动手、又愿意对交付负责的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好务实动手、也钻研系统（企业 R + 研究 I + 实务 E）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: If you remain curious about Ship Engineers work and are comfortable making judgments under medium risk, this career is worth considering.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field develops the ability to keep machinery under control while the ship moves. You must understand thermal and hydraulic systems, tolerate engine-room heat and noise and long periods at sea, and remain calm during failures. It suits hands-on, resilient people who love machinery.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: They tend to be hands-on, investigative, and enterprising (Realistic R + Investigative I + Enterprising E).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 如果你对Ship Engineers有持续好奇、又不排斥中风险下的判断，工程师值得考虑。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「在晃动里把机器看住」——既要读得懂热力与液压系统，也要扛得住机舱高温噪声与长期出海，还得在故障面前不慌。适合动手强、抗压、爱机械的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好实操、探究、也主导（现实 R + 研究 I + 企业 E）。

breadcrumb.label: Outdoor Power Equipment And Other Small Engine Mechanics

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who combine hands-on ability, mechanical interest, and practicality. They can spend half a day examining a disabled lawn mower and distinguish healthy from unhealthy exhaust smoke.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The practical appeal of this work is that a successful repair makes the machine run immediately. A disabled machine roars back to life through your hands, creating instant satisfaction. It suits hands-on people who enjoy machinery and dislike office work, finding comfort in oil and wrenches.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: A preference for hands-on practice, realism, and investigation (Realistic R + Investigative I + Conventional C).

breadcrumb.label: 户外动力设备与小型发动机机械师

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「动手 + 爱机械 + 务实」凑一块的人——能为一台趴窝的割草机趴半天，也分得清烟色好坏。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最实在的是「修好就能跑」——一台趴窝的机器经你手重新轰鸣，成就感立竿见影。适合动手强、爱机械、坐不住办公室的人，跟油污和扳手打交道反而自在。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好动手实操、重现实、也爱钻研（现实 R + 研究 I + 常规 C）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who combine speed, courtesy, and composure. Calls must connect, and people must feel reassured.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field most strongly develops speed and composure. Operators must listen and act quickly without losing calm amid confusion. It suits responsive, courteous people who can remain at a station for long periods.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers rules, initiative, and helping others (Conventional C + Enterprising E + Social S).

breadcrumb.label: 总机接线员（含应答服务）

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「快 + 礼貌 + 稳」凑一块的人——电话要通、人也要安。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「快和稳」——既要耳快手快，也要在忙乱里不慌；适合反应快、有礼貌、又坐得住的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好规矩、开创、也助人（常规 C + 企业 E + 社会 S）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who combine patience, listening ability, and a service mindset. Calls must be categorized quickly and transferred accurately, while speed, reassurance, and documentation remain balanced.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field most strongly develops listening and patience. Operators must interpret intent quickly, maintain a calm tone, and keep clear records. It suits detail-oriented people who can remain at a station, enjoy helping others, and find satisfaction in organizing chaotic calls.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: They prefer helping others, practicality, and order (Social S + Enterprising E + Conventional C).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「耐心 + 耳力 + 服务心」凑一块的人——来电要分得快也要转得准，速度和安抚要平衡也要会记录。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「耳力与耐心」——意图要分得快，语气要稳得住，记录要写得清。适合细心、坐得住、有服务心的人，也享受把混乱来电理顺的成就感。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好助人、务实、也守序（社会 S + 企业 E + 常规 C）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who combine steady hands + patience + exacting standards. Joints must align and finished work must look beautiful, while physical endurance and craftsmanship require balance and drawing literacy.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field develops hands-on craftsmanship. Setters must read drawings, calculate waste, and align every joint attractively. It suits steady-handed people who can concentrate and care deeply about the finished result.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers practical work, orderly processes, and enterprise (Realistic R + Conventional C + Enterprising E).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「手稳 + 耐心 + 较真」凑一块的人——缝要对得齐也要把成品交漂亮，体力和手艺要平衡也要会看图。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「手上功夫」——既要会看图和算损耗，也要把每一条缝对得舒服。适合坐得住、手稳、也愿意为成品较真的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好务实、守序、也经营（务实 R + 守序 C + 经营 E）。
